title: Late-night rollback dryrun annotations and client scripts
content:
Purpose:
- Run a low-risk, late-night dry-run of our rollback sequence and client-side escape scripts. Verify automation, manual steps, and telemetry triggers all behave as expected.
- Confirm that client scripts (SDK toggles, pin/unpin calls) can be executed from ops box without race conditions.

High-level plan (2am window):
1) Preflight (01:30):
   - Confirm canary traffic is at 10% for model:v2025-02-10. Note snapshot of current routing map.
   - Snapshot RBAC and API tokens (ops-token-late-night).
   - Ensure two SREs and one eng on-call present (Slack vocally confirmed).
2) Dry-run (02:00):
   - Execute scripted rollback but stop before actual model flip (dry-run mode).
   - Run client-side unpin for a synthetic tenant (tenant-sim-7) using test API key.
   - Emit synthetic traffic ramp (see traffic matrix below) from harness box into staging gateway and into production sandbox routing.
3) Validation (02:10 - 02:30):
   - Observe telemetry rules (prometheus alerts and console SLO dashboard).
   - Confirm client SDK fallback path is exercised and no orphaned leases remain.
4) Real rollback rehearsal (02:30):
   - Optionally proceed to actual rollback if all checks green. If not, abort and document problems.

Dry-run checklist (quick):
- [ ] Notify #serving-runtime-oncall and #platform-ops 20 minutes prior
- [ ] Verify canary cohort mapping exported: /tmp/canary-map-YYYYMMDD.json
- [ ] Backup current pin-state: redis key snapshots and console export
- [ ] Start prometheus query recorder (prom-query-runner)
- [ ] Ensure synthetic traffic harness version = v0.9.2 and uses test tokens
- [ ] Prepare rollback commands and keep them in ops vault (do not paste tokens in Slack)

Telemetry triggers to watch (simulated thresholds for dry-run):
- Error rate: HTTP 5xx rate > 0.5% on canary route for 5m window -> verbal escalation
- Latency: p95 generation latency > 500ms for more than 3 minutes
- Token burn: Token consumption delta > 3x expected baseline for test tenant
- Model divergence: KL divergence on n-gram loss (quick eval) > 0.12 -> flag quality regression
PromQL snippets (run in console if needed):
- 5xx rate (per-route): sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",route="/v1/generate",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (route)
- p95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
- KV cache miss rate: sum(rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))

Synthetic traffic matrices (sample ramps):
- Phase A (warmup, 02:00-02:03): 10 rps across 100 clients (short sessions, 8 token avg)
- Phase B (stress, 02:03-02:08): 40 rps across 400 clients (long tail prompts, 60 token avg)
- Phase C (steady observe, 02:08-02:20): 5 rps across 20 clients (replay of recorded customer prompts)
Notes: matrix targeted at canary nodes and shadow routes, use traffic tag = dryrun-20250211

Client-side scripts (ops box examples)
- Unpin a tenant (pseudo):
  curl -X POST https://private-console.redwood.internal/api/tenants/tenant-sim-7/unpin \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n    -d '{"reason":"dry-run rollback rehearsal","ticket":"JIRA-4521"}'

- Toggle feature flag via internal flip-service (idempotent):
  curl -X PATCH https://flip.internal/api/v1/flags/release-enable \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"enabled":false,"target":"tenant-sim-7","meta":{"dryrun":"true"}}'

- Recover pin (re-pin model v2025-02-10):
  # NOTE: run only after successful dry-run verification or during rollback rehearsal
  ./ops-scripts/repin.sh --tenant tenant-sim-7 --model v2025-02-10 --confirm

Known failure modes to validate in dry-run (things to repro intentionally):
- Race between pin/unpin and autoscaler: ensure we don't evict pre-warmed GPUs mid-swap.
- Token caching: clients using long-lived cached tokens may not pick up unpin; validate SDK TTL logic.
- Fallback loop: client retries combined with model failure can trigger traffic amplification; ensure backoff is honored.
- Metric propagation delay: some dashboards are ~45s delayed; factor into decision windows.

Escalation matrix (who to ping):
- 1st responder: @raj (SRE) Slack: raj.patel (onsite)
- 2nd: @aisha (serving eng lead) Slack: aisha.karim (remote)
- On-call PM: @cole (product) Slack: cole.nguyen
- Pager: SRE rotation (see oncall.redwood/sre)

Dry-run observation template (paste into doc after run):
- Time window: 02:00-02:20 UTC
- Steps executed: (list)
- Telemetry snapshots: attach prom screenshots or paste query outputs
- Client script logs: /var/log/ops/dryrun-YYYYMMDD.log (redact tokens)
- Problems encountered: (bullet)
- Action items: (assign, due date)

Postmortem quicknotes if something breaks during rehearsal:
- Capture exact commands used (copy from ops vault)
- Collect pod logs: kubectl -n serving logs -l app=canary -c runtime --since=30m > /tmp/canary-logs.txt
- Check autoscaler decisions: describe HPA and scaling events
- Re-run synthetic traffic against staging to reproduce

Open questions / TODOs (my notes):
- Can we add a dry-run flag in the flip-service to make unpin operations non-destructive? (If so, add TTL cleanup)
- Should synthetic traffic harness send a header that explicitly marks traffic as "dryrun" so billing/alerts ignore it?
- Need a reliable backup restore for pin state that restores within <60s. Current export/restore is ~2m in tests.
- Add ephemeral test tenants that auto-delete in 24 hours (so operators don't forget them).

Personal to-dos before run:
- [ ] Validate ops-token scopes and rotate temporary token (nadir ops box)
- [ ] Schedule a 30m pre-brief with Raj and Aisha (01:30 call)
- [ ] Create a short test run in staging tomorrow to validate scripts

Notes-to-self: keep the run conservative. The point is rehearsal and observability — prefer false-negatives over accidental customer impact. Document every minor divergence so we can tighten the playbook.

Reference links:
- Confluence rollback playbook: confluence.redwood/rollback-playbook (see section "late-night rehearsal")
- Jira: JIRA-4521 (ops dry-run)
- Dry-run harness repo: git@github.com:redwood/ops-dryrun-harness.git

End of scratchpad. Will update after rehearsal.
